title: Low Battery (CrossWave Cordless)
fullDescription:
E01 appears on CrossWave Cordless Max when the battery drops below operating voltage.

Charge for 4-6 hours until the battery indicator is solid.

fixSteps.title: Charge fully
fixSteps.instruction: Leave on dock 6 hours.

fixSteps.title: Replace battery
fixSteps.instruction: If runtime very short, install new pack.

whenToCallPro: Not required.

faq.a: Yes, store above 50%.

title: Brush Roll Jam
fullDescription: E02 means the brush roll could not rotate, typically hair, fibers, or thick carpet stalling the motor.

fixSteps.title: Remove brush
fixSteps.instruction: Open brush door, pull roll.

fixSteps.title: Cut debris
fixSteps.instruction: Carefully cut hair with scissors.

whenToCallPro: Not required.

faq.a: Yes under faucet between uses.

title: Water Tank Error
fullDescription: E03 on CrossWave/SpotClean indicates a tank is missing or improperly latched. The vacuum will not operate until both tanks are secured.

causes.cause: Clean tank not fully clicked in

fixSteps.title: Re-seat tanks
fixSteps.instruction: Remove and reinstall both until they click.

whenToCallPro: Not required.

faq.a: Both must be installed.

title: Motor Overload
fullDescription: E04 indicates the suction motor has drawn too much current from obstruction. Let cool and clear filters/hose.

fixSteps.title: Cooldown
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug 30 minutes.

fixSteps.title: Clean filter
fixSteps.instruction: Rinse pre-motor filter.

whenToCallPro: If recurs after cleaning.

faq.a: 24 hours.

title: Pump Fault
fullDescription: E05 on SpotClean/CrossWave indicates the solution pump is not delivering fluid; may be air-locked or failed.

fixSteps.title: Prime pump
fixSteps.instruction: Hold spray trigger 30 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Clean spray nozzle
fixSteps.instruction: Remove nozzle and flush with warm water.

whenToCallPro: If pump replacement needed.

faq.a: Bissell formula only.

title: Filter Cleaning Reminder
fullDescription: Filter indicator shows when routine cleaning is due; wash and dry to restore suction.

fixSteps.title: Remove filter
fixSteps.instruction: Open dirt tank, pull filter.

fixSteps.title: Wash & dry
fixSteps.instruction: Rinse, air dry 24h, reinstall.

whenToCallPro: Not required.

faq.a: Every 6 uses or monthly.

title: Dirty Water Tank Full
fullDescription: The dirty water tank has a float that shuts off suction when full to prevent overflow into motor.

fixSteps.title: Empty tank
fixSteps.instruction: Pour out, rinse, reinstall.

whenToCallPro: Not required.

faq.a: Rinse with vinegar.

title: Hose Blocked
fullDescription: SpotClean models can clog in the hose handle or tool, leading to weak or no suction.

fixSteps.title: Clear tool
fixSteps.instruction: Remove tool and flush with water.

whenToCallPro: Not required.

faq.a: Vacuum loose fiber first.

title: Drive Belt Broken
shortDescription: Brush belt snapped on Bissell upright.
fullDescription: Legacy Bissell uprights use stretch belts that snap with age or jams.

fixSteps.title: Open base
fixSteps.instruction: Remove screws and plate.

fixSteps.title: Install belt
fixSteps.instruction: Loop new belt on pulleys.

whenToCallPro: Not required.

faq.a: Check under machine for belt style.

title: Thermal Shutdown
fullDescription: Thermal protector on Bissell vacuums trips when airflow is restricted for too long; motor will resume after cooldown.

fixSteps.title: Cooldown
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug 45 minutes.

fixSteps.title: Clear blockages
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect hose, filters, brush.

whenToCallPro: If does not restart after cooldown.

faq.a: Automatically after cooling.

title: Battery low warning
shortDescription: Battery requires charging on cordless models
fullDescription: Bissell vacuum 'E06' indicates battery requires charging on cordless models. The unit stops or shows the warning indicator.

fixSteps.title: Power off and unplug
fixSteps.instruction: Turn off power; unplug if corded.

fixSteps.title: Address fault
fixSteps.instruction: Charge fully; replace battery if older than 2 years.

fixSteps.title: Clean filters and tanks
fixSteps.instruction: Rinse filter and tanks; refill clean water.

fixSteps.title: Test
fixSteps.instruction: Plug in / charge and test.
